title_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri dhe Orientim Perfekt !!
description_sq: Ne Don Bosko, ngjitur me kompleksin Fiore di Bosko, Shitet Apartament 1+1, me Vendndodhje dhe Orientim Perfekt!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e trete banim te nje pallati te ri te vitit 2024, me ashensor. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe bruto prej 60 m2 dhe siperfaqe neto prej 51 m2. Organizimi i apartamentit fillon me korridorin qe ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes bashke me ambientin e ngrenies dhe te gatimit, nje dhome gjumi me dalje ne ballkon, nje tualet dhe nje ballkon. Orientimi eshte nga veriu. Apartamenti eshte i sapoinvestuar totalisht nga pronari duke filluar nga sistemi hidraulik multistrat, tualet inkaso, sistemi elektrik, dyer, dritaret dopioxham, parket, patinim, etj, dhe eshte i pabanuar me pare. Zona ofron shume facilitete duke nisur nga lokacioni perfekt dhe per kete arsye eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per te jetuar ashtu edhe per investim duke qene se qirate jane shume te larta ne ate zone. Disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In Don Bosco, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!!
description_en: In Don Bosco, next to the Fiore di Bosco complex, 1+1 Apartment for sale, with Perfect Location and Orientation!!! The apartment is located on the third residential floor of a new building built in 2024, with an elevator. The apartment has a gross area of ​​60 m2 and a net area of ​​51 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room with the dining and cooking area, a bedroom with access to the balcony, a toilet and a balcony. The orientation is from the north. The apartment has just been fully invested by the owner, starting from the multi-layer hydraulic system, flush toilet, electrical system, doors, double-glazed windows, parquet, patina, etc., and it has not been inhabited before. The area offers many facilities starting from the perfect location and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment since the rents are very high in that area. It has full mortgage documentation.
